notes.title: Exciting News: Our Game is Ready to Launch on Steam!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that the moment we've all been waiting for has finally arrived! After much of hard work, dedication, and invaluable support from our amazing community, we are excited to inform you that Lorhaven: Cursed War is set to release on Steam!

Lead Lorhaven through haunted provinces threatened by undead in The Undying War. As a castle commander, recruit units strategically, discover legendary heroes, and delve into a story-driven campaign. Dynamic maps, a map editor, and living lore enhance the immersive world. Strategic decisions on and off the battlefield determine Lorhaven's fate. Are you ready to be the savior Lorhaven desperately needs?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773405/8ab28b38a034af31b821b2c7af92ecf98e2f80dc.png[/img]

notes.title: # Game Update
notes.content:
Greetings!

A game update bringing new stuff for the game.
Enjoy.

[list]
[*] Added bonus: Forests near lumberyards yields more gold, same for mountains near Mines
[*] Shrines provide restoration for units.
[*] Added healing and shield magic for Spellcasters.
[*] Introduced Plague and Freezing Winds for Undead mages.
[*] Checked and balanced all buildings for bonuses.
[*] Fixed incorrect unit type display on the recruit panel.
[*] Changed capture icon and added animation, so it won't confuse with any other action
[*] Included a unique sound for capture.
[*] Fixed unit type on recruit panel display.
[*] Upon capture, different factions now have buildings set according to their faction.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy this update.
Stay tuned for more.
Have a great week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773405/581f36b770967c5fcc4ec4e2492a06fa1699dc29.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.content:
We're delighted to unveil 'Lorhaven Cursed War' on Steam Early Access! Embark on a thrilling journey through a world fraught with curses and conflict. As you dive into the game's early stages, your feedback becomes a vital part of crafting an extraordinary experience. Join the Lorhaven community on Steam Early Access, where the war begins, and together, let's shape the destiny of this cursed realm!
